test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

MARS ∶ NLBZSQTR ∶∶ PLUTO ∶ QOMKVTUSPN ∶ EARTH ∶ ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

Here, MARS ∶ NLBZSQTR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33f1df4d146b626574ff3c43b3b53c41171350ba2176e7bde580b8aa04f9aaf2.png] 

For, PLUTO ∶ QOMKVTUSPN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/691e110a4632de18526beaf39e6764531acd7904fed89ee53e94556c4cf805f8.png] 

Similarly, for EARTH:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/002e270f5c17a678962958b382cd11e2d117aa35665bc179a766ddc07a339f32.png] 

So, 'EARTH' will be coded as 'FDBZSQUSIG'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

8d
